bio.text: Brett Easterbrook, a Republican, has represented District 65 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 7, 2018; his current term ends on November 4, 2026, and he is not running for re-election in 2026.

Easterbrook has served as a plant controller at Evonik Degussa and as a licensed residential contractor, and later as director of finance and controlling in North and South America for Outokumpu Stainless Steel.
